objectives.description: Understand pass/fail and a reported mark without confusing institutional approval with passing.

objectives.description: Request and identify completion/certification documents without asserting universal qualification equivalence.
objectives.rationale: Certificate/diploma and document collection are selected; no equivalence of national qualification hierarchies or institutional endorsement is claimed.

objectives.description: Follow ordinary review, correction and recall instructions.
objectives.rationale: Review, memorization, correction, error/rule and recollection patterns selected; A1 learning actions and A2-P-154 olvidar supply existing earlier/cross-cell contrasts.

objectives.description: Identify a written task and produce or complete its requested form.
objectives.rationale: Completion, drawing and composition-task recognition selected; A1-W literacy/instructions and A2-F comparative/qualitative language cover unchanged task primitives.

objectives.description: Ask for a sheet, ruler, folder or printed/copy output.
objectives.rationale: Sheet/ruler/folder and printer/copier actions selected; A1-W stationery/furniture are inherited without a second classroom object inventory.

objectives.description: Name a field of study without introducing an entire subject lexicon or degree hierarchy.
objectives.rationale: Medicine, law and computing fields are selected; A1-W mathematics/history and language-as-subject meanings remain prerequisites, not new A2 names for the same fields.

objectives.description: Distinguish employee, customer, owner and routine occupational roles.
objectives.rationale: Employee/job versus operator/sales/public/temporary-care roles and retirement status selected; A1 familiar occupations remain prerequisites.

objectives.description: Identify ordinary work premises, equipment and required clothing.
objectives.rationale: Workroom, factory and clothing contrasts selected; A1 office/shop/company and devices remain shared context.

objectives.description: Ask about a contract, work hours and a day/night shift as practical arrangements.
objectives.rationale: Contract, shift/night-shift, part/full time, day off/break and flexible/remote arrangements selected; A1 schedule/start/end and F time compose actual hours. Later jornada retained as explicit disposition.

objectives.description: Ask and report what work pays and distinguish earning from receiving payment.
objectives.rationale: Earning, regular-pay alternatives and money-receipt action selected; paying/amount/currency remain inherited and no legal wage entitlement is taught.

objectives.description: Arrange an interview and identify the CV and application-related documents.
objectives.rationale: Candidate interview/CV, work experience, offer/position and meeting booking/confirmation selected; formal request, vacancy and availability/requirement nouns retain explicit later dispositions.

objectives.description: Follow a routine instruction to meet, deliver, attend or notify a colleague.
objectives.rationale: Attendance, gathering/meeting, handover, notification and customer attention selected; same A1 colleague and task meanings inherited.

objectives.description: Identify ordinary software, portable computing and its user-facing controls.
objectives.rationale: Programme/app/portable-device, browsing, controls and installation selected; basic on/off operations retain explicit A1-versus-A2 disagreements.

objectives.description: Open, save, locate, rename, move and delete a named digital file; distinguish file and physical archive.

objectives.description: Select and copy/cut/paste simple digital text without teaching software internals.
objectives.rationale: Select/copy/cut/paste/erase are linked and digital-versus-physical granularity remains explicit; higher technical explanation not required.

objectives.description: Send, receive, download, upload and attach a course/work file.
objectives.rationale: Generic sending/receiving plus upload/download/attachment/link/size contrasts selected. Pure downloaded participial status is excluded as independent lexical coverage.

objectives.description: Recognize connection/access state and ask for routine help, not troubleshoot network architecture.
objectives.rationale: Connection, account/identifier/password and sign-in/out or connect/disconnect contrasts selected; fault/repair-state and restart recognition included without network diagnosis.

objectives.rationale: Field labels and scientific-person role selected; physical energy remains B1 disposition and technical mechanisms are genuinely outside this A2 scenario.
